_comment: Verify-only mode and licence-observation settings (items #96 H-21, #97). callers: deny by default; each id maps to a file path (relative to the week-1v2 directory) and a sha256 pin of that file; vet() checks the calling frame's __file__ and its hash. A null sha256 means registered-but-not-yet-built and is always denied. Update a pin after every edit of the caller file. This is an integrity check only (callers share the OS user; D-025). portal_map: host suffix -> portal id (empty until #71's portal list is wired; else the registrable domain is used).
